prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one large square 4096x4096 game sky texture, a flat illustration to wrap over an overhead sky dome.
Reference image: the provided coastal game screenshot is a STYLE reference ONLY for its SKY: large flat color regions with very thin organic contour lines. Ignore its characters, buildings, terrain and composition, and DO NOT copy its turquoise/green palette.
Primary request: create an airy, hand-drawn sky made of broad, elongated, interlocking irregular cloud sheets and open blue areas. Think of the long broken contours and broad flat cloud color partitions in the reference. Cloud regions should stretch off the canvas edges as a continuous sky, with a few smaller wisps. Several broad sheets distributed over the entire canvas, including the middle; balance about 45 percent pale cloud regions with 55 percent open blue. Calm clear day.
Style: strictly flat 2D color fills, extremely subtle blue-grey hairline outlines tracing the irregular cloud boundaries. Meandering, naturally stepped and gently jagged contours, tapered ends, occasional little breaks and blue gaps within the sheets. Restrained illustrated game aesthetic.
Color palette: low-saturation powder blue background #afcbdc, pale warm grey/ivory cloud fill #e3e7df, one secondary pale blue-grey #cbdce0, fine muted blue-grey contour #8ca4af. Keep the palette blue and ivory, never turquoise, mint, green or high saturation.
Composition: a full-frame continuous sky pattern viewed overhead, no horizon, no landscape, no perspective vanishing point, no circular frame. Fairly large irregular flowing regions rather than rows of separate little clouds. The central area must contain both blue and part of a broad cloud sheet, without a centered hero object. Clean, simple, crisp readable flat colors.
Avoid: isolated rounded puffy cloud icons, scalloped cookie or biscuit outlines, cotton balls, spheres, thick extruded edges, 3D models, volume, gradients, realistic lighting/shadows, glow, painterly blotches, texture noise, sun, moon, stars, objects, writing, labels, watermarks.
integration: One texture projected continuously over the sky hemisphere without longitude seams or zenith pinching. The generated painting supplies cloud region masks, rendered with the existing muted blue sky palette, ivory/pale blue-grey flat fills and a fine screen-sized contour. The same painting is recolored for night. Slow rotation respects reduced-motion preference. No cloud models loaded. Overview uses the existing plain sky.
